rows.label: qst701109_msg0001
rows.name:
The master helped me out a lot in the
past. He picked me up when I was a
wreck from all my reckless behavior.

rows.label: qst701109_msg0002
rows.name:
He'd scold me and worry about me.
There was nothing in it for him, yet
he was the only adult kind to me.

rows.label: qst701109_msg0003
rows.name:
I decided back then that if Master was
ever in trouble, I'd help him
no matter what.

rows.label: qst701109_msg0004
rows.name:
So I came prepared for the worst, but
I was relieved when it turned out
to be just Wotta.

rows.label: qst701109_msg0005
rows.name:
It makes him an easy target... Ah,
don't tell the master I said that!?
